verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official command-line tool, zepctl, that provides full access to administer users, threads, Context Graphs and data operations from the terminal, and a probe confirms the dedicated CLI docs page exists. The evidence establishes the CLI and its scope but says little about how it suits AI-native or agent-driven use. missing for 10: evidence of agent-friendly CLI features (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth, scripting), installation/command reference details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: zepctl is a command-line interface for administering Zep projects. It provides full access to Zep, enabling you to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations from the terminal.
